Title: Generally Available: Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server flexible maintenance

Body.Content:
Take control of your schedule with flexible maintenance, now generally available. You can reschedule Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server maintenance activities to a time that best suits your business operations. With a maximum 30-day reschedule window, you can avoid maintenance disruptions during peak hours. You can easily set flexible maintenance for your database instances using the Azure portal and automate using Azure CLI, so you can manage maintenance across multiple servers in a single step.

Learn more.
